texts.text:
Hi Alex,
You asked how I make time for reading. Here is my new plan. I get home at five and have a snack. Then I do homework for half an hour before taking a short break. After dinner, I read for fifteen minutes. I leave my phone in the kitchen during that time. On Wednesdays, I have basketball practice, so I read on the bus instead. My plan is not the same every day. I still leave some free time because I sometimes need longer for a difficult task.
Best,
Mia
items: What does Mia do after her snack?
Homework
Basketball practice
Reading on the bus
I get home at five and have a snack.
Then I do homework for half an hour before taking a short break.
篮球训练只安排在周三，不是每天吃过点心后的活动。
公交车上阅读是周三的调整，不是通常的下一步。
Then 承接前面的 have a snack，因此吃完点心接着做作业。
How long does Mia read after dinner?
Fifteen minutes
Thirty minutes
Five minutes
I read for fifteen minutes
半小时是这一段作业时间，不是阅读时间。
five 指到家钟点，没有说只读五分钟。
Where is the phone during reading?
In the kitchen
In her school bag
On the bus
I leave my phone in the kitchen
邮件没有说把手机留在书包里。
公交车是周三的阅读地点，不是通常放手机的地点。
Why does Mia leave some free time?
Some tasks may take longer
She never makes plans
She has practice every day
I sometimes need longer for a difficult task
她已经给出了具体计划，并不是不做计划。
文中只提周三训练，没有说每天训练。

texts.text:
A WEEK WITH ROOM TO CHANGE
Ben's notebook has three columns: must do, would like to do, and can wait. At the start of the week, returning a library book goes in the first column. Making a birthday card goes in the second. Sorting every photo goes in the last. Ben checks the list after school, not every ten minutes. On Thursday, his cousin needs help with a model. Ben moves the photos to Saturday. He finishes the library task first because the book is due that day. A useful plan helps him choose; it does not fill every minute.
items: Which task is in the first column?
Returning a library book
Making a birthday card
Sorting every photo
returning a library book goes in the first column
生日卡放在想做的事项中，不在第一栏。
照片整理在可以等的事项中。
When does Ben check the list?
After school
Every ten minutes
Only on Saturday
Ben checks the list after school
not every ten minutes 明确排除了频繁查看。
周六是整理照片的新安排，不是唯一查看日。
Why does the library task come first on Thursday?
The book is due that day
The photos are already sorted
His cousin dislikes books
the book is due that day
照片只是改到周六，尚未完成。
文中没有表弟不喜欢书的信息。
What is the plan mainly for?
Helping Ben make choices
Filling every minute
Stopping Ben from helping others
A useful plan helps him choose
结尾明确说计划不是填满每一分钟。
Ben 实际上调整计划帮助了表弟。

texts.text:
AFTER-SCHOOL GARDEN CLUB
Our first meeting is on Tuesday in the school garden. Meet by the green gate at four, not at the front entrance. Wear shoes that cover your feet. The teacher will show us how to use the small tools before we begin. Do not take a tool without asking. We will work in pairs and finish at four forty. If rain makes the path slippery, we will meet in Room 12 and make plant labels instead. Please tell Ms Lin if you cannot come. Beginners are welcome; you do not need your own tools.
items: Where should students meet first?
By the green gate
At the front entrance
In Room 12 every week
Meet by the green gate at four
通知明确不是正门入口。
12教室只是雨天的替代地点。
What happens before students use tools?
The teacher shows them how
They take tools home
They work alone
The teacher will show us how to use the small tools before we begin
没有让学生先把工具带回家。
活动要求两人合作，不是独自操作。
What will the club do if the path is slippery?
Make plant labels indoors
Run along the path
Cancel all future meetings

Who can join?
Beginners without their own tools
Only experienced gardeners
Only students with tools

texts.text:
BEFORE OUR CLASS VISIT
We are visiting a small local museum on Friday. Put your group number on a card and keep it in your pocket. At the entrance, each group will choose a meeting point with its teacher. Stay with your group during the visit. If you cannot find the others, ask a museum worker for help and wait at the agreed point. Do not leave the building to search outside. You may write notes, but check the signs before taking photographs. At the end, tell your teacher you are back before getting on the school bus.
items: What should students keep in their pocket?
A card with their group number
A museum tool
A photograph of every room
Put your group number on a card
没有要求携带博物馆工具。
拍照要先看标志，文中未要求拍遍每间房。
Who helps choose the meeting point?
The teacher
A bus passenger
An online friend
with its teacher
公交乘客没有参与集合点安排。
网上朋友没有出现在参观安排中。
What should a separated student do?
Ask a worker and wait at the agreed point
Leave the building to search
Get on any bus alone
ask a museum worker for help and wait at the agreed point
原文明说不要到楼外寻找。
最后须先向老师报到，再上校车。
What should students check before taking photos?
The signs
Their homework marks
The weather at home
check the signs before taking photographs
作业成绩与拍照许可无关。
家里的天气不能说明馆内是否允许拍照。

texts.text: During lunch, Leo was quieter than usual. His friend asked if he wanted to play football. Leo said, "I did not sleep well, and I am worried about a class talk." Instead of saying, 'Just be happy,' his friend listened. They went to their class teacher together. The teacher helped Leo divide the talk into three small parts. She also suggested that he tell an adult at home how he was feeling. Leo still had some worries that afternoon, but he no longer felt he had to handle everything alone. Asking for help was his first step, not a sign of failure.
items: What is Leo worried about?
A class talk
A missing football
A broken lunch box
I am worried about a class talk.
朋友邀请踢球，但没有丢球的情节。
午饭是事情发生的时间，没有饭盒损坏的信息。
How does the friend respond after Leo describes his worries?
Listens to Leo
Tells Leo to stop talking
Promises to solve everything
his friend listened
朋友没有让 Leo 停止说话。
一起找老师不等于承诺包办所有问题。
How does the teacher help with the talk?
Divides it into three parts
Cancels every class talk
Writes the whole talk herself
divide the talk into three small parts
没有取消全班的演讲。
老师帮忙分步骤，不是代写全部内容。
What changes by the end?
Leo feels less alone
Every worry disappears
Leo refuses all help
he no longer felt he had to handle everything alone
文中仍说 Leo 有一些担心，不是全部消失。
他已经接受朋友和老师的帮助。

texts.text:
Dear Ms Chen,
Could I speak to you after our lesson? I have felt tired this week. I try to finish every task before taking a break, and I often stay up late. Yesterday, I could not follow a simple instruction in class. I do not want to guess why this is happening. Could you help me decide which adult I should talk to? I would also like to make a more manageable homework plan. Please do not read this email to the class. I would rather discuss it with you privately first.
Thank you,
Sam
items: Why is Sam writing?
To ask for a private conversation
To give medical advice
To cancel the whole course
Could I speak to you after our lesson?
Sam 在求助，没有向别人提供诊断建议。
邮件没有要求取消课程。
What does Sam often do?
Stays up late
Takes too many long breaks
Leaves every task unfinished
I often stay up late
Sam 说做完任务才休息，不是休息过多。
文中没有每项任务都不完成的信息。
What help does Sam request?
Choosing an adult to talk to
A guess about a medical cause
A public announcement
help me decide which adult I should talk to
Sam 明确不想猜原因，不是在索要猜测诊断。
Sam 要求先私下沟通，不是公开广播。
Which detail shows a wish for privacy?
Not reading the email to the class
Asking after the lesson
Mentioning yesterday
Please do not read this email to the class
课后时间方便交谈，但这句话本身不直接提出保密要求。
提到昨天只是说明时间，不能单独表达隐私要求。

texts.text:
TRY A SMALL WORD TEST
Choose five useful words from your own lesson notes. Read one example for each word and say what it means. Then close the notes and write the words from memory. Check your answers afterwards, not while you are writing. Put a small mark beside words you could not recall. The next day, try those words in new sentences. At the end of the week, test yourself again without looking first. Getting a word right just after copying it is useful practice, but it does not show that you will remember it later.
items: How many words should the learner choose?
Five
One
Ten
Choose five useful words
one 指每个词的一条例句，不是总词数。
步骤没有要求选择十个词。
When should answers be checked?
After writing from memory
While copying each letter
Before any attempt
Check your answers afterwards
边抄边检查不能检验独立回忆。
先看答案会暴露要回忆的词。
What happens the next day?
Using difficult words in new sentences
Throwing away the notes
Copying the whole dictionary
try those words in new sentences
步骤没有要求扔掉笔记。
任务只围绕所选词，不是抄词典。
What does immediate copying NOT prove?
Later recall
That practice took place
That the learner saw the word
it does not show that you will remember it later
原文承认这是一种练习，不能说没有练习。
抄写说明看到了单词，但不能证明以后记得。

texts.text: Our reading group tried a new routine for two weeks. Before opening a dictionary, we read the whole short text and marked only the words that stopped us understanding the main idea. We guessed a meaning from the sentence, then checked it. At first, Amy wanted to translate every word. Later, she found she could understand the writer's purpose without doing that. Ben still needed help with some sentences, so the group discussed one example together each day. We did not compare test marks. We wanted to find a method each person could use, not prove that one method works for everyone.
items: What does the group do before using a dictionary?
Reads the whole text
Translates every word
Compares test marks
we read the whole short text
逐词翻译是 Amy 最初的想法，不是新流程的第一步。
原文明说没有比较考试分数。
Which words are marked?
Words blocking the main idea
Every long word
Only words about colours
the words that stopped us understanding the main idea
长词不一定影响主旨，原文没有按长度筛选。
没有限定颜色词。
How does the group help Ben?
Discusses an example each day
Stops him reading
Claims he needs no help
discussed one example together each day
Ben 仍参与阅读，不是被阻止阅读。
原文说他仍需要帮助。
What is the report careful NOT to claim?
One method suits everyone
The routine lasted two weeks
Amy changed her approach
not prove that one method works for everyone
两周是文中明确给出的试用时间。
Amy 后来的做法确实发生了变化。

title: 认识自己与管理时间：读懂信息与用意
goal: 先判断文本要解决什么问题，再用原文证据核对细节、因果和作者的用意。
pitfall: 相近的词或出现过的数字不一定回答本题；推断也必须有原文支持。

texts.text:
Tuesday
I thought I was bad at organising things because my bag was always full. Today I emptied it before making a new plan. I found three old notices, two library books and a broken pen. I returned the books and put tomorrow's materials in a separate pocket. At first, I expected a whole evening of work. It took ten minutes. I am still slow at some tasks, but I can change one habit at a time. Tomorrow I will check my bag after dinner. I do not need to become a completely different person overnight.
items: What makes the writer question the old self-description?
A small change takes less time than expected
A friend buys a new bag
Every task becomes easy
At first, I expected a whole evening of work.
It took ten minutes.
没有朋友买新书包的情节。
作者仍说自己做一些事很慢，不是所有事情都变容易。
把原先预计的一整晚与实际的十分钟比较，才能判断这次改变比预想的省时。
Where are tomorrow’s materials put?
In a separate pocket
In the library
Beside the broken pen
in a separate pocket
图书馆是还书地点，不是明日材料的位置。
坏笔是清理时发现的物品，没有说把材料放在它旁边。
When will the writer check the bag tomorrow?
After dinner
During every lesson
At midnight
after dinner
计划只定在晚饭后，没有说每节课检查。
文中没有午夜检查的安排。
Which idea best fits the diary?
A habit can change in small steps
A label decides everything forever
Change must happen overnight
I can change one habit at a time
作者的经历表明“不会整理”的标签不是永久结论。
结尾明确否定一夜之间彻底改变的要求。

texts.text:
KNOW YOUR WORKING TIME
A task can look small until you try it. Before making a weekend plan, choose one ordinary task and note when you start and finish. Include getting your materials ready. If a task takes twenty minutes once, do not assume it will always take exactly twenty minutes. Leave space for a harder example or a useful question. Put a necessary task before an optional one, and include time to rest. Review the plan at the end. Ask what helped, rather than calling yourself lazy because one part took longer than expected.
items: What should be included in the time record?
Preparing the materials
Only the final minute
A guessed finishing time
Include getting your materials ready
只记最后一分钟会漏掉实际准备时间。
指南要求记录开始和结束，不是猜结束时间。
What does one twenty-minute result show?
The time for that attempt
The exact time for every future attempt
That the task is always easy
do not assume it will always take exactly twenty minutes
原文明确不能把一次结果当作以后固定用时。
用时不能单独证明题目永远简单。
Which task should usually come first in this plan?
A necessary task
Every optional task
Sorting all photos
Put a necessary task before an optional one
可选任务排在必需任务之后。
指南没有提出照片整理这一具体任务。
What is the suggested response to a delay?
Review what helped
Use a negative label immediately
Remove all rest time
Ask what helped
原文不建议因为一次延迟就说自己懒。
指南明确要求留出休息时间。

title: 了解职业与责任：读懂信息与用意
goal: 先判断文本要解决什么问题，再用原文证据核对细节、因果和作者的用意。

texts.text:
A JOB BEHIND THE SCENES
For our school careers project, we interviewed a fictional theatre worker called Robin. Robin does not act on stage. She checks that the objects actors need are ready and safe to use. Before a performance, she follows a list and asks the actors about changes. A small missing object can interrupt a scene, so careful checking matters. When something breaks, she tells the team rather than hiding it. She cannot promise that nothing will ever go wrong, but she can make sure the right people know about a problem. Robin enjoys practical work and working with others. She says the job requires patience as well as imagination. After the interview, we realised that a successful show depends on many people the audience may never notice. We had asked about an ordinary working day, not just the most exciting moments.
items: What is Robin’s main responsibility?
Preparing objects used by actors
Playing every leading role
Selling all audience tickets
Robin does not act on stage.
She checks that the objects actors need are ready and safe to use.
Robin 明确不在台上表演。
访谈没有把售票作为她的工作。
She 指上句的 Robin；她检查演员需要的物品是否备齐、能否安全使用。
Why does she use a list?
A missing object may interrupt a scene
Actors never change their plans
She wants to avoid all conversations
A small missing object can interrupt a scene
她还会询问变化，不能推出演员从不改动。
工作需要沟通，不是避开交流。
What does she do when something breaks?
Tells the team
Hides the problem
Promises nothing can go wrong
she tells the team rather than hiding it
原文明确不隐瞒问题。
她没有保证永远不出问题。
What does the class learn?
Unseen work helps a show succeed
Only actors contribute
A job consists only of exciting moments
depends on many people the audience may never notice
结尾强调不被观众注意的人也有贡献。
他们特意了解普通工作日，不只看精彩时刻。

texts.text:
THE PERSON WHO CHECKS THE ROUTE
This is an invented profile for a classroom project. Chen works with a team that prepares walking routes for visitors. He reads maps, checks opening times and asks local workers about changes. One morning, a bridge on a planned route is closed. Chen changes the route and explains the extra walking time before the group sets off. He does not tell visitors to cross the closed bridge to keep the trip shorter. Later, a student asks whether his work is simply walking around. Chen shows her the notes, phone calls and safety checks behind a one-hour visit. He also keeps records so the next guide can understand the decision. The student changes her question from 'Is the job fun?' to 'What must you check each day?' Learning about a job means looking at its responsibilities, not only its name.
items: What changes that morning?
A bridge is closed
Every visitor cancels
The route becomes shorter
a bridge on a planned route is closed
文中没有所有访客取消活动。
新路线增加步行时间，不是变短。
When is the extra walking time explained?
Before the group leaves
Only after everyone returns
Never
before the group sets off
不是等结束后才说明。
Chen 确实解释了变化。
Why are records useful?
The next guide can understand the decision
They replace every safety check
They prove routes never change
so the next guide can understand the decision
记录不能替代实际检查。
当天路线已经变化，不能证明永不改变。
What is the main message?
Understand a job through its responsibilities
Choose a job by its name alone
Ignore work done before a visit
looking at its responsibilities
结尾明确不仅看职业名称。
访谈特别展示出发前的准备工作。

texts.text:
OUR CLASSROOM PLANT CORNER
First, move the notebooks away from the pots. Put a cloth under each pot so water does not reach the shelf. Check the soil before watering; do not simply empty a full bottle into every plant. Ask the teacher if you are unsure what a plant needs. After the task, wipe the shelf and return the bottle. Two students will check the corner on Friday. Their job is to notice a problem and report it, not to blame the person who watered last time. A finished task includes leaving the place ready for the next person.
items: What goes under each pot?
A cloth
A notebook
A full bottle
Put a cloth under each pot
笔记本先被移开，不是放在盆下。
瓶子用于浇水，不是垫在花盆下面。
What should happen before watering?
Check the soil
Empty every bottle
Blame another student
Check the soil before watering
指南明确不要机械倒整瓶水。
检查不是追责，不能先怪别人。
What is the Friday pair’s role?
Notice and report problems
Decide who deserves blame
Buy every plant
notice a problem and report it
原文明确不是责怪上次浇水的人。
任务没有要求购买植物。
When is the task properly finished?
When the place is ready for others
As soon as water is poured
When the shelf is left wet
leaving the place ready for the next person
浇水只是其中一步，还需擦拭和归位。
完成要求清理，不是把架子留湿。

texts.text:
A TABLE READY FOR OTHERS
Nina helped prepare the classroom for a family reading evening. She first put all the chairs in straight lines. Then she tried walking between them with a bag of books. The space was too narrow. She asked a classmate to help move two chairs and test the path again. Before leaving, they checked the table for sharp pencil ends and put the borrowed books in order. Nobody gave a prize for moving the chairs twice. Still, when the families arrived, they could find seats and books easily. Nina learned that checking the result is part of doing a job well.
items: How does Nina discover the narrow space?
By trying to walk through it
By counting the windows
By asking for a prize
walking between them with a bag of books
窗户数量不能检验椅子间的通行空间。
她没有先索要奖励。
What do they move?
Two chairs
Every table
The classroom door
move two chairs
文中没有移动所有桌子。
没有拆移教室门的情节。
What else is checked before they leave?
The table for sharp pencil ends
Every family’s phone
The price of new chairs
checked the table for sharp pencil ends
活动没有检查来访者手机。
没有购买新椅子，不涉及价格。
What does Nina learn?
Check whether the result works
A second attempt means failure
Only prize-winning work matters
checking the result is part of doing a job well
移动两次解决了问题，不是失败的证明。
没有奖品，但工作仍然帮助了来访家庭。

texts.text:
WHICH NOTEBOOK OFFER?
The following prices are invented for a classroom comparison. Shop A offers one notebook for six yuan. Shop B sells a pack of three for fifteen yuan. Both shops show the same page count, but the covers are different. Jia needs one notebook now and has twelve yuan to spend. Her friend says the three-pack is cheaper per notebook, so she should buy it immediately. Jia checks the total price before deciding. Fifteen yuan is more than her current budget, and she does not need three notebooks today. She chooses one from Shop A and keeps the other six yuan. The lowest price per item is useful information, but it is not the only reason to buy something. The advertisement does not say that the paper quality has been tested, so Jia cannot assume either notebook will last longer.
items: How much is the three-pack?
Fifteen yuan
Twelve yuan
Six yuan
a pack of three for fifteen yuan
十二元是 Jia 的预算。
六元是 A 店单本价格。
Why does Jia not buy the pack now?
It exceeds her budget and her current need
It contains fewer pages
Shop B is proved dishonest
Fifteen yuan is more than her current budget, and she does not need three notebooks today.
两家页数相同，不能说 B 店更少。
没有证据表明商家不诚实。
整包售价15元，超过12元预算；一包3本，而Jia今天只需1本。两个条件都要核对，单价较低不能抵消它们。
How much does Jia keep after buying one?
Six yuan
Nine yuan
Fifteen yuan
keeps the other six yuan
十二减六是六，不是九。
十五元是整包价格，不是剩余钱数。
Which conclusion is NOT supported by the advert?
One notebook lasts longer
The pack costs fifteen yuan
The page counts match
Jia cannot assume either notebook will last longer.
整包售价在开头明确给出。
same page count 明确说明页数一致。

texts.text:
CLASS PICNIC BUDGET: FICTIONAL FIGURES
Money available: sixty yuan.
Fruit: twenty-four yuan.
Reusable cups: eighteen yuan.
Reserved for an unexpected need: eighteen yuan.
The three amounts add up to the available money. Lin keeps the reserve separate instead of treating it as money that must be spent. Before buying the cups, she checks whether the school already has suitable ones. A classmate offers to lend some, so the group waits for the teacher to confirm that arrangement. Lin writes down who has offered the cups and when they should be returned. She does not count the cups as a free gift. If the loan is confirmed, the group will update its plan rather than quietly spending the saved money on something else. A clear budget shows choices and responsibilities as well as numbers.
items: How much is reserved for an unexpected need?
Eighteen yuan
Twenty-four yuan
Sixty yuan
Reserved for an unexpected need: eighteen yuan
二十四元用于水果。
六十元是全部可用金额。
What does Lin check before buying cups?
Whether suitable cups already exist
Whether every coin can be spent
Which fruit is the sweetest
whether the school already has suitable ones
预算不要求花光全部资金。
这里检查的是杯子需求，不是水果口味。
Why does Lin record a return time?
The cups may be borrowed
The cups are a confirmed gift
The reserve has disappeared
when they should be returned
原文说不能把借用当作赠送。
没有储备金丢失的信息。
What should happen if the loan is confirmed?
Update the budget plan
Spend savings without discussion
Ignore the original agreement
the group will update its plan
原文明说不悄悄把省下的钱另作花销。
记录借用安排说明仍需履约。

texts.text:
A LABEL THAT STAYS PUT
Our class kept losing the paper labels on its storage boxes. We first blamed the tape, but we had not checked where the labels fell off. We observed the boxes for a week and found that hands often rubbed the same corner. A group suggested placing the labels inside clear pockets. Another group wanted to write directly on the boxes. We tested both ideas on spare boxes, not on the borrowed ones. The pockets let us change the words easily, while the writing was harder to remove. We chose pockets for boxes whose contents changed often. The test did not prove that pockets were best for every purpose. It helped us match a solution to one particular problem. We kept the unsuccessful examples too, so another class could understand what we had tried.
items: What does the class do before choosing a solution?
Observes and tests the problem
Blames tape and stops
Changes every borrowed box
We observed the boxes for a week and found that hands often rubbed the same corner.
We tested both ideas on spare boxes, not on the borrowed ones.
最初虽怀疑胶带，但后来没有停在责怪上。
实验只用备用盒，不改借来的盒子。
先观察标签脱落的位置，再用备用箱测试两个方案；这两步完成后才选择适合的做法。
Where are the ideas tested?
On spare boxes
On borrowed boxes
On the classroom windows
on spare boxes, not on the borrowed ones
原文明说不是借来的盒子。
没有在窗户上试验。
Why are pockets chosen for changing contents?
The words can be changed easily
The labels never need reading
Writing is proved useless everywhere
The pockets let us change the words easily
标签仍需让人阅读，不是无需查看。
结论只针对一类需求，没有全盘否定书写。
Why keep unsuccessful examples?
To explain what was tried
To hide the test
To claim every idea succeeded
so another class could understand what we had tried
保存例子是让别人了解，不是隐藏。
文中承认有未成功的例子。

texts.text:
THE CROOKED NOTICE
Rui: Our notice keeps hanging at an angle. Should we buy a new board?
Jia: First, let us check the string. The left end seems longer than the right.
Rui: I can shorten it. But let us take the notice down before changing anything.
Jia: Good idea. We should not pull it while it is above someone's head.
Narrator: They measure both ends on a table, adjust the string and hang the notice again with their teacher's help.
Rui: It is straight now. The board was not the problem.
Jia: We should write down what worked. Next time, someone else may face the same difficulty.
Narrator: Their solution costs no extra money. More importantly, they have learned to inspect the cause before replacing the whole object. A small repair can still require careful thought and safe working arrangements.
items: What is Rui’s first proposed solution?
Buying a new board
Changing the classroom
Painting the table
Should we buy a new board?
没有提出换教室。
桌子用于测量，不是要粉刷。
What do they inspect?
The two ends of the string
The cost of every board
The colour of the wall
The left end seems longer than the right
他们没有先比较所有板子的价格。
墙的颜色不能解释两边悬挂长度差。
Why is the notice taken down?
To adjust it away from people below
To throw it away immediately
To stop everyone reading notices
We should not pull it while it is above someone's head.
拿下来是为安全调整，不是立即丢弃。
修好后重新挂上，仍供人阅读。
What is the central lesson?
Inspect the cause before replacing everything
A new board always solves the problem
Repairs never need help
inspect the cause before replacing the whole object
原来的板子没有问题，买新板不是必然答案。
他们在老师帮助下重新悬挂，不能说修理都不需帮助。

title: 朋友之间说清楚：读懂信息与用意

texts.text:
Hi Ben,
I was upset when you left our game yesterday. I thought you were angry with me. Later, I heard that you had to meet your little sister at the gate. I need to ask you instead of guessing. Next time, could you tell me before you leave? I will also try to ask a clear question when I do not understand something. Would you like to play again at lunchtime tomorrow? It is fine if you already have another plan. Please let me know so I can arrange my lunch break.
Mia
items: What did Mia first think?
Ben was angry with her
Ben had lost his bag
Ben disliked every game
I thought you were angry with me
邮件没有说 Ben 丢了包。
一次离开不能推出他讨厌所有游戏。
Why did Ben actually leave?
To meet his little sister
To avoid all his friends
To buy a new game
meet your little sister at the gate
实际原因是接妹妹，不是躲开所有朋友。
没有买游戏的情节。
What does Mia want to do differently?
Ask rather than guess
Guess more quickly
Never play with Ben again
I need to ask you instead of guessing.
她反思的是先问清楚，不是猜得更快。
她已经发出再玩一次的邀请。
How does Mia leave room for Ben’s choice?
She accepts that he may have another plan
She demands an immediate yes
She says lunch is cancelled
It is fine if you already have another plan
允许另有安排，不是强迫立刻答应。
她只在约午休活动，没有取消午饭。

texts.text:
Sam: I cannot find the drawing we made together.
Nina: I put it in a folder so it would not get wet.
Sam: I looked everywhere. I thought you took it home.
Nina: I am sorry I did not tell you where it was. I was trying to protect it, not keep it for myself.
Sam: Thank you for explaining. Can we agree on one place for our shared work?
Nina: Yes. Let us use the blue folder on the shelf and tell each other if we move it.
They write both names on the folder. The problem ends with a clear agreement, not a decision about which friend is a better person.
items: Why does Nina put the drawing in a folder?
To protect it from water
To take it as her own
To hide Sam’s name
so it would not get wet
她明确说不是据为己有。
两人最后都署名，没有隐藏 Sam 的名字。
What had Sam guessed?
Nina took it home
The teacher had sold it
The folder was broken
I thought you took it home.
没有老师出售作品的线索。
文中没有文件夹损坏。
What agreement do they make?
Use a shared place and report moves
Never move anything for any reason
Keep separate secret copies
tell each other if we move it
协议允许移动，但要相互告知。
他们使用共享文件夹，不是秘密分开保存。
How is the disagreement resolved?
By explaining and making an agreement
By labelling one friend as bad
By throwing the drawing away
The problem ends with a clear agreement
结尾特意不对朋友的人品下结论。
画仍被保存，没有被丢弃。

title: 家庭分工与社区生活：读懂信息与用意
goal: 先判断文本要解决什么问题，再用原文证据核对细节、因果和作者的用意。

texts.text:
OUR SHARED KITCHEN
We have made a new family plan. Dad cooks on Monday and Wednesday. Mei washes the vegetables on those days, and her brother sets the table. After dinner, everyone puts away their own bowl. Saturday jobs are different: we choose them after checking who is free. If someone cannot do a task, they should tell the family before it is time to begin. The plan is on the fridge, but it is not a test of who works fastest. It helps us share the work and notice when someone needs help.
items: What does Mei do on Monday and Wednesday?
Washes vegetables
Cooks every dish
Sets every table
Dad cooks on Monday and Wednesday.
Mei washes the vegetables on those days, and her brother sets the table.
做饭由 Dad 负责，不是 Mei 做全部菜。
摆餐具是弟弟的任务。
those days 指前句的周一和周三；在这两天，Mei 的任务是洗菜。
How are Saturday jobs chosen?
According to who is free
By copying Monday exactly
By choosing the fastest person
after checking who is free
周六另作安排，不是照搬周一。
计划明确不是速度比赛。
What should someone do if they cannot help?
Tell the family before the task
Say nothing until next week
Hide the plan
tell the family before it is time to begin
等到下周才说会耽误当天分工。
隐藏计划不能让家人提前调整。
What is the plan’s purpose?
Sharing work and noticing needs
Proving one person is best
Giving Dad every task
share the work and notice when someone needs help
文中没有给家人排名的目的。
其他人也有任务，不是全部交给 Dad。

texts.text: The lift in our building stopped working one afternoon. A notice said a worker was coming, but our neighbour needed help carrying her shopping upstairs. My father asked whether she wanted a hand before picking anything up. I carried the light bag while he took the heavier one. We left the bags inside her door with her permission. Later, I suggested making a list of everyone's needs. Dad said we should ask people first and keep their private information safe. Helping a neighbour does not mean deciding everything for them or collecting details they do not want to share.
items: What problem does the neighbour face?
Carrying shopping upstairs
Finding a new shop
Writing the repair notice
carrying her shopping upstairs
购物已经买好，不是在寻找商店。
维修通知已有，邻居不需要代写。
What happens before Dad helps?
He asks permission
He opens the neighbour’s bag
He records every private detail
asked whether she wanted a hand
没有未经允许翻看物品。
Dad 后来反而提醒保护隐私。
Which bag does the narrator carry?
The light one
Both heavy bags
No bag at all
I carried the light bag
较重的袋子由父亲拿，不是孩子拿两个重袋。
作者实际参与了搬运。
What does Dad think of the proposed list?
People should be asked first
All details should be public
Neighbours should never be helped
we should ask people first
征求同意不等于公开所有资料。
故事展示了帮助邻居，不能推出不应帮助。

title: 志愿服务与公共帮助：读懂信息与用意
goal: 先判断文本要解决什么问题，再用原文证据核对细节、因果和作者的用意。
pitfall: 相近的词或出现过的数字不一定回答本题；推断也必须有原文支持。

texts.text:
HELP AT THE BOOK SWAP
Our community room needs helpers this Sunday, from ten to eleven thirty. Some visitors may need help finding books in large print. Volunteers will show them the shelves and carry books if asked. You do not need to read private notes inside donated books. Give any personal documents you find to the adult organiser without showing them around. Please come fifteen minutes early for a short introduction. If you can stay for only part of the event, tell the organiser before Sunday. Useful help begins with understanding what people actually want.
items: When does the event start?
At ten
At nine forty-five
At eleven thirty
this Sunday, from ten to eleven thirty
九点四十五是提前到场时间，不是活动开始。
十一点半是结束时间。
Why should helpers arrive early?
For an introduction
To keep all the best books
To read private notes
for a short introduction
志愿者不是提前抢走好书。
通知明确不需要读私人便条。
for a short introduction说明早到的目的：参加简短介绍。它不表示正式活动提前开始，也不是提前挑走好书或阅读私人便条。
What should happen to a personal document?
Give it privately to the adult organiser
Show it to every visitor
Post it online
Give any personal documents you find to the adult organiser without showing them around.
传给所有人会扩大私人资料的传播。
通知没有让人上传文件，处理方式是交给成人组织者。
交给成人组织者与without showing them around要一起读：把文件交给指定的人，同时不让它在访客之间传看。不能先公开内容，再以最后交给成人为由当作符合要求。
What should a helper who cannot stay long do?
Tell the organiser in advance
Leave without saying anything
Change the event time alone
tell the organiser before Sunday
临时不告而别不符合提前说明的要求。
个人不能擅自修改整个活动时间。

texts.text: We expected to spend Saturday painting signs at the community garden. When we arrived, the organiser asked us to listen first. Several visitors could not read the small writing on the old signs. We made larger labels and placed them where people could see them without stepping into the beds. One visitor tested a label and suggested a darker pen. We changed it before making the rest. At the end, we asked whether the new signs were useful. We had not simply done the job we imagined. We had changed our work after hearing the people who would use it.
items: What does the organiser ask the volunteers to do first?
Listen
Paint every old sign immediately
Walk into the beds
asked us to listen first
他们先了解需求，不是立即把所有牌子重画。
新牌位置要避免进入种植区。
What was wrong with the old signs?
The writing was too small
They named the wrong city
They were all missing
could not read the small writing
问题是字小，不是城市名称错误。
旧牌仍在，只是难读。
Why do they change the pen?
A visitor suggests a darker one
They want a brighter box
The organiser dislikes gardening
suggested a darker pen
没有因为想要鲜艳盒子而换笔。
组织者对园艺的态度不是换笔原因。
What makes the help useful?
Listening to users and adapting
Ignoring visitors’ comments
Finishing the imagined task unchanged
changed our work after hearing the people who would use it
他们采用了访客建议，没有忽略意见。
任务根据真实需求调整，并非原样执行想象中的计划。

title: 合作项目：职责、顺序与进度
goal: 根据流程词和人物分工，读懂检查、分享条件与合作中的贡献。
pitfall: 把内部检查当成公开发布，把朗读者当作全部工作的负责人，忽略分工与条件。

texts.text:
PROJECT MEETING: A CLASS AUDIO GUIDE
Our team agreed to create a short guide to the school art display. Before dividing the work, we listed the information a visitor would need. Each picture needed a title, a location and a short explanation from its maker. Jia would collect the makers' permission, Ben would check the words, and Lin would practise reading the script. We chose Friday afternoon as our first check, not as the public release time. If one part was late, its owner would tell the group early so that we could adjust the order of work. We also agreed that the reader would not receive all the credit. Finding accurate information, checking permission and testing the guide were equally necessary. At the next meeting, each person would bring one completed part and one question for the group.
items: What is the project?
A short audio guide
A new school building
A competition to choose one artist
a short guide to the school art display
没有建造新校舍。
团队在制作导览，不是在选出唯一艺术家。
Who collects permission?
Jia
Ben
Lin
Jia would collect the makers' permission
Ben 的任务是检查文字。
Lin 的任务是练习朗读稿件。
Jia负责收集作者许可；Ben检查文字，Lin练习朗读。要把人物与各自负责的事情对应，不能因为都参与项目就互换职责。
What is Friday afternoon for?
The first check
A promised public release
The final prize ceremony
our first check, not as the public release time
原文明确不是公开发布时刻。
没有颁奖典礼安排。
Friday afternoon被明确用作first check，后半句又排除了public release time。日期相同不代表用途相同，不能把检查日读成公开发布日。
How is credit viewed?
All necessary roles matter
Only the reader matters
Only the fastest person matters
the reader would not receive all the credit
团队明确不把功劳全给朗读者。
会议没有按谁最快来分配功劳。

texts.text:
Dear team,
We have a problem with the model for our exhibition. The base is ready, but the labels use three different styles. Before anyone rewrites them, could we agree on one clear format? I suggest a title, two sentences and the maker's name on each label. Please send corrections to one shared document rather than creating separate versions. We can keep a note of who changed what, so earlier work is not lost without discussion. Sam is away today, so I have asked whether he wants someone to read his suggestions aloud at tomorrow's meeting. Silence does not mean he has no ideas. We still have time to check our choices together. A shared result should make room for each person's contribution, even when different people need different ways to join in.
Best,
Mia
items: What problem needs solving?
Inconsistent label styles
A missing base
A cancelled exhibition
the labels use three different styles
模型底座已经完成，并未丢失。
邮件没有取消展览。
Where should corrections go?
One shared document
Several secret versions
Only on paper at home
send corrections to one shared document
分开建立版本正是邮件要避免的做法。
没有限定只能写在家里的纸上。
Why keep a change record?
To avoid losing work without discussion
To identify the worst teammate
To stop all future changes
so earlier work is not lost without discussion
记录的目的是保留和沟通，不是评出最差队员。
仍允许修改，只需留下清楚记录。
What does Mia NOT assume about Sam?
That silence means no ideas
That he is away today
That he may want help sharing suggestions
Silence does not mean he has no ideas.
Sam 当天缺席是邮件明确的信息。
Mia 已主动询问他是否需要代读建议。

title: 家乡变化：时间线与证据
goal: 借助时间词排出变化，比较同一地点的得失，区分可核实的事实与未知信息。
pitfall: 把后来用途当作最初用途，只看好处或损失，或给未知年份补一个看似合理的数字。

texts.text:
THE OLD STATION ROOM
This fictional display tells the story of a neighbourhood station. Years ago, the room beside the platform was used for storing tools. When the railway route changed, the room stood empty. Residents later asked for a place to share photographs of the area. With permission, they cleaned the room and opened a small history display. Visitors can now compare pictures of the same street taken at different times. The display does not claim that every change was an improvement. One picture shows trees that were removed when a road was widened; another shows a new path that made walking easier. The volunteers record where each photograph came from and mark uncertain dates as unknown. Remembering a place carefully means keeping both useful changes and things people miss in view.
items: What was the room originally used for?
Storing tools
Selling photographs
Teaching every school lesson
was used for storing tools
分享照片是后来的用途。
没有承担全校课程的记录。
What can visitors compare?
The same street at different times
Only pictures of distant countries
Every railway ticket price
Visitors can now compare pictures of the same street taken at different times.
展示聚焦本地街道，不是只展示外国。
没有列出所有铁路票价。
same修饰street，different修饰times：换的是时间，比较对象仍是同一条街道。不能把它理解成来自不同城市、毫不相关的照片。
How are uncertain dates handled?
They are marked unknown
They are guessed and presented as facts
The pictures are always destroyed
mark uncertain dates as unknown
志愿者没有把猜测当成确定日期。
日期不明不代表必须毁掉照片。
uncertain说明年份证据不足，unknown保留这个状态；不是随便猜一个年份，也不是销毁照片。记录来源与确认年份是两件事。
What attitude does the display encourage?
Considering both benefits and losses
Calling every change better
Rejecting every new path
keeping both useful changes and things people miss in view
原文明说不声称每次变化都是进步。
新路便利步行，是同时考虑的好处之一。

texts.text:
A FUTURE FOR THE EMPTY CORNER
Near our school, an unused corner collects wind-blown rubbish. Our class has drawn two possible plans: a seating area or a small planting space. These are suggestions, not approved building projects. Before choosing, we would ask residents who use the nearby path, including people with pushchairs or wheelchairs. A beautiful design should not make their journey harder. We also need to learn who would maintain the space after the first week. Buying plants once is different from caring for them over several seasons. Our first action will be to prepare questions for a community meeting. We will not start digging on land we do not manage. Thinking about the future of a place includes listening, permission and long-term work, not simply drawing an attractive picture.
items: What is the current status of the plans?
Suggestions
Approved building projects
Finished gardens
These are suggestions, not approved building projects.
原文明说没有得到工程批准。
规划尚在讨论，不是建成的花园。
Why ask people using pushchairs or wheelchairs?
The design should not block their journey
They must buy every plant
They are the only residents
should not make their journey harder
征求使用者意见不等于要求他们买植物。
including 表示包括，并非只有这些居民。
Which long-term question matters?
Who will maintain the space
Which colour looks best for one day
Who can dig fastest without permission
who would maintain the space after the first week
一天的外观不能解决长期照料问题。
文中明确不在无权管理的土地上动工。
What will the class do first?
Prepare questions for a meeting
Start digging immediately
Announce a completed project
prepare questions for a community meeting
还需倾听和许可，不能直接开挖。
没有已完成的项目可以宣布。

title: 跨文化交流与礼貌：读懂信息与用意
goal: 先判断文本要解决什么问题，再用原文证据核对细节、因果和作者的用意。
pitfall: 相近的词或出现过的数字不一定回答本题；推断也必须有原文支持。

texts.text:
AN EVENING OF FAMILY FOOD STORIES
Our school language club invites visitors to share a story about a dish their family enjoys. No one has to bring food or describe a whole country's customs. Different families may do things differently. Speakers can bring a photograph, but they should ask permission before showing other people in it. The event begins at six in the school hall and ends at seven. Listeners are encouraged to ask open questions, such as 'When does your family make this?' rather than 'Do all people from your country eat this?' If a visitor does not wish to answer a personal question, we will move on politely. The purpose is to learn from particular experiences, not turn one person's meal into a rule about millions of people.
items: What must speakers bring?
No food is required
A complete meal for everyone
Proof of a national rule
No one has to bring food
活动没有要求为所有人提供一餐。
目的不是证明某条全国统一规则。
What should happen before showing a photograph of others?
Ask permission
Assume everyone agrees
Publish it everywhere first
ask permission before showing other people in it
照片中有他人不等于已获同意。
先广泛发布再询问不是征求许可。
Which question best fits the event?
When does your family make this?
Does everyone in your country eat this?
Why must every family be the same?
When does your family make this?
把一位来宾当成全国代表与活动目的相反。
通知强调不同家庭可以不同。
How should an unwanted personal question be handled?
Move on politely
Demand an answer
Guess the answer publicly
we will move on politely
来宾可以不回答，不能强求。
公开猜测个人情况不是尊重界限。

texts.text:
Mia: I was surprised when your family ate dinner later than mine.
Alex: Was it difficult to wait?
Mia: A little. Next time, may I ask about the meal time before I visit?
Alex: Of course. We sometimes eat earlier too. Yesterday's time was not a rule for every evening.
Mia: I nearly told my class that people here always eat late. I am glad I asked.
Alex: You can say what happened on your visit, but perhaps do not turn it into a statement about everyone.
Later, Mia writes in her notebook that curiosity is useful when it comes with careful questions. She can describe her own experience accurately without treating it as a national custom. She also plans to explain her needs politely instead of silently feeling uncomfortable. Neither friend has to pretend that differences do not exist; they simply avoid making the differences larger than their evidence supports.
items: What surprised Mia?
The later dinner time
A missing dinner invitation
A rule against asking questions
ate dinner later than mine
她已经到访用餐，不是缺少邀请。
Alex 明确欢迎她提前询问。
What does Alex clarify?
The time is not a fixed rule
Every evening has the same late meal
Nobody may discuss meals
not a rule for every evening
这句话正是否定每天都一样。
对话鼓励礼貌讨论，没有禁止谈吃饭时间。
What should Mia avoid telling her class?
That everyone there always eats late
What happened on her particular visit
That she asked about meal times
people here always eat late
具体经历可以如实叙述。
询问时间本身确实发生，可以说清。
What does the reflection support?
Describe evidence and communicate needs politely
Pretend there are no differences
Treat one visit as proof about everyone
avoid making the differences larger than their evidence supports
结尾明确不必假装不存在差异。
一次拜访不能证明所有人的生活习惯。

texts.text:
THE BENCH AFTER RAIN
A silver line along the seat,
A little cloud beneath my feet.
I do not sit; I stop and see
The upside-down shape of a tree.
One passing wheel can break the view,
Then quiet water makes it new.

Programme note: This original classroom poem describes a tree reflected in a puddle near a bench. The speaker calls the water a little cloud, but this is an image, not a weather report. The passing wheel disturbs the reflection. The last line suggests that the picture forms again when the water becomes still. You do not have to imagine exactly the same colours as another reader. When discussing the poem, point to a word or line that supports your idea. A feeling is easier to share when you connect it to something the writer has actually described.
items: What is the upside-down tree?
A reflection in water
A tree planted upside down
A picture sold on the bench
a tree reflected in a puddle
说明文字明确是倒影，不是倒着种树。
没有出售图片的情节。
What disturbs the view?
A passing wheel
A falling mountain
A reader’s notebook
One passing wheel can break the view
诗中没有山体坠落。
笔记本没有被写成扰动水面的原因。
What does “a little cloud” do in the poem?
Creates an image
Gives a measured weather forecast
Names an official cloud type
this is an image, not a weather report
说明明确不是气象预报。
没有为云作科学分类。
How should a reader support an interpretation?
Refer to a word or line
Claim every reader must imagine one colour
Ignore the actual description
point to a word or line that supports your idea
说明允许读者想象不同颜色。
感受仍需联系文本，不能完全忽略描写。

texts.text:
A POSTER THAT MADE ME STOP
At our school exhibition, one poster showed an empty chair beside a bright window. There was no title until I looked at the small label below: 'Waiting for a friend.' At first, I thought the picture was simply about furniture. The title changed what I noticed. The empty space beside the chair began to feel important. Another visitor thought the scene felt peaceful rather than lonely. We did not try to decide which feeling was officially correct. We each explained which detail had led us there. The artist later said she had left the space open on purpose so viewers could imagine who might arrive. I learned that describing an artwork can begin with what is visible before moving to a personal interpretation. The interpretation should remain an interpretation, not become a fact about the artist's whole life.
items: What changes the writer’s first response?
Reading the title
Buying the chair
Watching a film
The title changed what I noticed.
没有购买椅子的情节。
展览中没有播放这部电影。
How does another visitor feel?
The scene is peaceful
The artwork is officially wrong
The window must be removed
felt peaceful rather than lonely
不同感受不等于判作品错误。
访客没有提出拆除画中窗户。
Why does the artist leave the space open?
So viewers can imagine someone arriving
Because she forgot to finish it
To report every fact about her life
so viewers could imagine who might arrive
艺术家明确是有意留白，不是忘记完成。
一幅画不能交代她全部人生事实。
What distinction does the writer learn?
Observation and personal interpretation
Expensive and cheap furniture
Correct and incorrect visitor names
what is visible before moving to a personal interpretation
本文的收获不是家具价格比较。
没有核对参观者姓名的内容。

texts.text:
OUR MIXED-SKILL BALL GAME
Teams have four players, and everyone must touch the ball before the team can score. The aim is to practise passing, not to let the strongest player do everything. Before the game, agree on the playing area and stop signal. If someone falls, stop and check with the teacher before continuing. Players should explain a disagreement calmly and accept the agreed rules. Winning is enjoyable, but it is not a reason to hide a mistake. After the game, each team will name one helpful action by the other team and one skill it wants to practise next.
items: What must happen before a team scores?
Everyone touches the ball
Only the strongest player touches it
Someone changes the rules secretly
everyone must touch the ball
规则要求每个人参与，不是只靠最强者。
没有允许私自更改规则。
What should happen if someone falls?
Stop and check with the teacher
Continue at greater speed
Hide the incident
stop and check with the teacher
规则要求暂停，不是加速继续。
隐藏情况不符合先检查的要求。
How should a disagreement be discussed?
Calmly
By insulting opponents
By ignoring every rule
explain a disagreement calmly
侮辱对手不等于冷静解释。
原文还要求接受事先约定的规则。
What will teams do afterwards?
Recognise a helpful action by opponents
Discuss only the final score
Choose who deserves all the blame
one helpful action by the other team
赛后还谈帮助行为和技能，不只看比分。
没有要求选出应受全部责备的人。

texts.text: Near the end of a school race, Ben noticed that a younger runner had missed the turn marker. Ben called to him and pointed out the correct path. He did not push the runner or leave the marked route himself. The younger runner returned to the right path and finished behind Ben. Afterwards, Ben's friend asked why he had helped a competitor. Ben said that following the same route mattered more than keeping quiet about a mistake. He was pleased with his own run, but he also wanted a fair race. Helping had not required him to stop trying his best.
items: What mistake does the younger runner make?
Missing a turn marker
Changing the finishing line
Pushing Ben
had missed the turn marker
终点线没有被改动。
文中没有年轻选手推 Ben 的情节。
How does Ben help?
Calls and points
Pushes the runner
Leaves his own marked route
called to him and pointed out the correct path
原文明确没有推人。
Ben 自己没有离开标记路线。
Who finishes first of these two runners?
Ben
The younger runner
They finish together
finished behind Ben
年轻选手在 Ben 后面完成。
behind 表示在后，不是并列到达。
What does Ben’s action show?
Trying hard can go with fairness
Helping means giving up effort
Silence always makes competition fair
Helping had not required him to stop trying his best.
结尾明确帮助不等于停止尽力。
Ben 认为指出路线错误比保持沉默更符合公平。

texts.text:
THE UNFINISHED KITE
Ella promised her younger cousin a kite for the weekend. By Friday evening, its paper tail was still missing. She could have put the bright frame in a box and pretended it was finished, but she remembered how carefully her cousin had chosen the colours. Ella sent a message explaining the delay. Her cousin replied, 'Could we finish it together?' On Saturday, they cut a tail from spare paper and tested the kite in the garden with an adult. It rose, fell and rose again after a small adjustment. Ella had expected a perfect gift to show that she cared. Instead, the shared work became the part her cousin talked about afterwards. The unfinished kite did not become a good gift because mistakes never matter. It became meaningful because Ella was honest about the problem and made room for someone else.
items: What is missing on Friday?
The paper tail
The whole frame
The chosen colours
its paper tail was still missing
风筝架已经有了，不是整个缺失。
表弟已经选过颜色。
What does Ella do about the delay?
Explains it in a message
Pretends the gift is complete
Blames her cousin
sent a message explaining the delay
她没有把未完成品伪装成完成品。
没有责怪表弟。
What does the cousin suggest?
Finishing it together
Buying a much bigger gift
Never trying the kite
Could we finish it together?
建议是共同制作，不是买更大的礼物。
后来两人确实试飞。
What makes the gift meaningful?
Honesty and shared work
The claim that mistakes never matter
Its high price
honest about the problem and made room for someone else
原文特意否定“错误永远无关紧要”的说法。
材料来自备用纸，价格不是文章的重点。

texts.genre: book review of an invented story
texts.text:
REVIEW: THE DOOR IN THE WALL
This is a review of an invented classroom story, not a published book. Its main character, Jo, finds an unused door in a school wall and imagines a secret room behind it. Most of the story follows her questions rather than a series of exciting accidents. Jo eventually learns that the door once led to a small store cupboard. The discovery sounds ordinary, but the writer makes it matter: Jo has listened to older neighbours and learned how the school changed. I liked the quiet ending because it answered the original question without pretending that every mystery hides treasure. Readers who want constant action may prefer another story. My recommendation is based on the kind of reading I enjoy, not on a claim that this is the best story for everyone. The review gives away the explanation of the door, so readers avoiding spoilers should stop before that part.
items: What kind of work is being reviewed?
An invented classroom story
An official history textbook
A real published bestseller
an invented classroom story, not a published book
开头明确不是官方历史教材。
作品是课堂虚构，不能当作真实畅销书。
What once lay behind the door?
A store cupboard
A room full of treasure
A large theatre
a small store cupboard
结尾没有发现宝藏。
没有大型剧院。
Why does the reviewer like the ending?
It makes an ordinary discovery meaningful
It adds constant accidents
It proves all mysteries hide treasure
the writer makes it matter
评论说故事重在提问，不是连续事故。
评论明确不假装每个谜题背后都有宝物。
What limit does the recommendation include?
It reflects personal taste
It suits every reader equally
It reveals no ending information
the kind of reading I enjoy
作者没有声称适合所有人。
评论承认透露了门的解释，含有剧透。

texts.text:
Dear Grandma,
Yesterday we visited a small town during its spring market. I expected every stall to sell the same food, but families had brought many different things. One stall showed how to fold a paper bird. I asked before taking a photograph of the maker's hands. She said yes, but asked me not to include a child beside her. I kept the photograph just as we agreed. My favourite part was listening to a shopkeeper explain why his family still uses an old recipe. It was one family's story, not a rule for the whole town.
Love,
Jia
items: What surprises Jia?
The variety at the stalls
The absence of all visitors
The lack of any paper activity
families had brought many different things
集市中有摊主和孩子，没有说无人来访。
文中明确有折纸鸟活动。
What does Jia do before taking a photo?
Asks permission
Photographs every child
Promises to sell it
I asked before taking a photograph
Jia 获得的是特定拍摄许可，不是拍所有孩子。
没有出售照片的承诺。
What condition does the maker give?
Do not include the child
Never photograph the folded bird
Publish the child’s name
not to include a child beside her
要求针对不拍孩子，不是禁止拍纸鸟。
文中没有让 Jia 公开孩子姓名。
How should the recipe story be understood?
As one family’s experience
As a rule for the entire town
As proof that all new food is bad
one family's story, not a rule for the whole town
原文明说不能推广成全镇规则。
传统食谱故事没有否定所有新食物。

texts.text:
OUR CLASS CULTURE FAIR
Bring one object, drawing or short story connected with a celebration you know. It can be a family tradition; it does not have to represent a whole country. Explain who uses it and what it means to them. Do not bring valuable or fragile objects. A drawing is enough. Our visitors will leave questions on cards, and presenters may choose which questions to answer. The fair starts after lunch on Thursday in Room 6. There is no prize for the oldest tradition or the most expensive object. We want careful listening and clear explanations, not a competition between families.
items: What can a student bring?
A drawing of a celebration object
Only a valuable original object
A complete national history
one object, drawing or short story
通知明确图画也可以，并非必须贵重原物。
材料可以是家庭习俗，不要求完整国家历史。
What should the explanation include?
Who uses the object and its meaning
Every family’s private address
Its price alone
Explain who uses it and what it means to them.
通知没有要求私人地址。
活动不是比价格，不能只讲售价。
Who chooses which questions to answer?
The presenters
Every visitor individually
Only a prize judge
presenters may choose which questions to answer
参观者可以提问，但不能代展示者决定是否回答。
活动没有这种奖项评委。
What is the fair meant to encourage?
Listening and clear explanations
Competition between families
Buying expensive objects
careful listening and clear explanations
最后明确不是家庭间的比赛。
不鼓励携带贵重物品，更没有要求购买。

title: 用事实介绍有贡献的人：读懂信息与用意
goal: 先判断文本要解决什么问题，再用原文证据核对细节、因果和作者的用意。

texts.text:
A QUIET CONTRIBUTION
The person in this profile is fictional. For many years, Ms Rao helped a neighbourhood group record the stories behind old photographs. She did not claim to remember every name or date. When she was unsure, she wrote a question beside the picture and asked other residents whether they had evidence. In one case, two people remembered different years for the same street celebration. Ms Rao kept both accounts instead of choosing the more exciting one. Later, a dated programme helped the group resolve that question. She also asked people whether their photographs could be displayed publicly. A picture lent for a discussion was not automatically a gift to the exhibition. Her contribution was not one dramatic discovery. It was the patient work of checking, asking permission and leaving clear records for the next volunteer. The group could build on her work because it could see how each claim had been reached, including the ones that remained uncertain. Recognising that kind of contribution means describing the work accurately rather than inventing impressive achievements.
items: How does Ms Rao handle uncertain information?
Records questions and seeks evidence
Invents a definite date
Chooses the most exciting account
she wrote a question beside the picture
她没有把猜测写成确定日期。
文中明确不按哪个说法更精彩来选。
What helps resolve the disagreement about a year?
A dated programme
A larger photograph frame
The volunteer’s popularity
a dated programme helped the group resolve that question
相框大小不提供年份证据。
人气高低不能决定过去的事实。
What must be checked before publicly displaying a borrowed photograph?
Permission for that use
Whether the frame looks expensive
Whether the story sounds exciting
She also asked people whether their photographs could be displayed publicly.
是否获准公开展示与相框是否昂贵无关。
故事有趣不能代替照片所有者的许可。
What is Ms Rao’s contribution mainly based on?
Patient and traceable work
Invented dramatic achievements
Remembering every detail perfectly
checking, asking permission and leaving clear records
结尾明确不编造显赫事迹。
开头说她不声称记得所有名字和日期。

texts.text:
WHAT COUNTS AS A CONTRIBUTION?
In this invented interview, a school reporter speaks with Mr Wen, who has helped organise an accessible reading group. The reporter first asks how many people he has 'changed forever'. Mr Wen asks her to choose a more careful question. He can describe what the group offers, but he cannot measure every reader's whole life.
He explains that volunteers prepare large-print notes, leave clear walking space and ask participants what support they want. Some readers attend often; others come only once. Both experiences belong in an honest account. A participant's private comments should not be turned into an advertisement without permission.
The reporter rewrites her questions. She asks what changed in the room, how the group gathers suggestions and what still needs work. The answers are less dramatic, but they show real decisions and limits. Her final article calls the group a continuing effort rather than a perfect solution. Respectful reporting can recognise useful work without giving one person all the credit or claiming that every difficulty has disappeared.
items: Why is the first question changed?
It makes an unmeasurable claim about people’s lives
It asks about a room feature
It gives too little praise for every visitor
he cannot measure every reader's whole life
房间变化是后来提出的具体问题，不是原问题的缺点。
改问不是为了夸大赞扬，而是为了问得准确。
Which action is mentioned?
Preparing large-print notes
Recording every visitor secretly
Removing all walking space
volunteers prepare large-print notes
没有秘密录制所有访客。
志愿者要留出通行空间，不是移除空间。
What requires permission?
Using private comments in advertising
Asking what still needs work
Calling the effort unfinished
A participant's private comments should not be turned into an advertisement without permission.
原文鼓励了解尚未完成的工作。
如实称为持续努力不是擅用个人评论。
How does the final article describe the group?
A continuing effort
A perfect solution to every problem
One person’s complete achievement
a continuing effort rather than a perfect solution
原文明说不称为完美方案。
文章也不把集体功劳全给一个人。

title: 公共规则与个人信息保护：读懂信息与用意
goal: 先判断文本要解决什么问题，再用原文证据核对细节、因果和作者的用意。

texts.text:
BEFORE YOU SHARE A CLASS PHOTO
Ask what the photograph is for before agreeing to share it. A picture suitable for a private class chat is not automatically suitable for a public page. Check whether everyone shown has agreed to that particular use. Look at the background as well: a noticeboard may show names, phone numbers or other details. If someone asks you not to include them, respect that choice instead of trying to persuade them in front of the class. You can choose a photograph of the project itself or make an original drawing. If you have already shared something inappropriately, tell a trusted adult and ask for help limiting further sharing. Deleting one copy does not guarantee that every copy has disappeared. A careful decision before posting is easier than trying to regain control afterwards.
items: What should be checked first?
The purpose of sharing
How many likes it might receive
Whether it looks fashionable
Ask what the photograph is for
点赞数量不能替代用途确认。
外观流行与是否得到特定用途许可无关。
Why does the background matter?
It may show personal details
It always improves privacy
It makes all permission unnecessary
a noticeboard may show names, phone numbers or other details
背景可能泄露资料，并非天然保护隐私。
背景安全也不能替代对他人的许可。
What is a suitable alternative if someone does not want to appear?
Use a project-only picture
Pressure the person publicly
Post the same photo secretly
a photograph of the project itself
原文要求尊重选择，不是当众施压。
秘密发布仍违背对方选择。
What warning does the guide give about deletion?
Other copies may still exist
Every copy must disappear
Adult help is never needed
Deleting one copy does not guarantee that every copy has disappeared.
一次删除无法控制所有副本，不能保证每个副本都会消失。
原文建议向可信任的成人求助，并没有说永远不需要帮助。

texts.text:
WELCOME TO THE STUDY ROOM
This room is shared by readers of different ages. Keep conversations quiet and use headphones only at a level that does not disturb others. A seat left empty for a few minutes may still be in use; ask the room worker before moving another person's belongings. Do not photograph visitors without asking. If you want to show the room in a school project, the worker can help you find a time when the tables are empty. Report a problem calmly rather than posting a stranger's picture with an accusation. These rules apply to everyone, including regular visitors. They are intended to make the space usable, not to stop reasonable questions. If a rule is unclear, ask the worker for an explanation. A shared room works better when people understand both their own needs and the effect of their actions on others.
items: What should a reader do before moving belongings from a seat?
Ask the room worker
Assume the owner has left forever
Photograph the owner first
ask the room worker before moving another person's belongings
空几分钟不等于主人永久离开。
拍照不能替代确认座位使用情况。
How can a school project show the room without visitors?
Ask about a time with empty tables
Secretly photograph all readers
Demand that every reader leave
a time when the tables are empty
秘密拍摄违背通知要求。
工作人员协助选择时段，不是让学生强迫别人离开。
Who must follow the rules?
Everyone, including regular visitors
Only first-time visitors
Only younger readers
including regular visitors
常客也包括在内，不只约束新访客。
规则适用于不同年龄，不只年轻人。
What can someone do if a rule is unclear?
Ask for an explanation
Ignore every rule
Post accusations immediately
ask the worker for an explanation
不明白应先询问，不是全部忽视。
通知反对直接公开指责陌生人。

title: 介绍家乡文化与自己的身份：读懂信息与用意

texts.text:
MANY WAYS TO BELONG
Our class exhibition introduces objects that connect us with places we call home. One student brings a drawing of a river path where she walks with her grandfather. Another records a family word for a particular kind of basket. A third describes a bus route that helped him get to know a new neighbourhood after moving. The objects are ordinary, but the explanations show different kinds of belonging.
We have not asked anyone to prove that their family has lived in one place for a certain number of years. People can feel connected with more than one place. Each presenter decides which personal details to share. The labels explain whose experience is being described, rather than claiming that everyone in the town has the same story. Visitors are invited to add a question or a respectful connection from their own experience. The exhibition is not a contest to identify the most 'authentic' resident. It is a chance to notice how language, memory and everyday journeys can become part of a person's identity.
items: What links the exhibited objects?
Personal connections with home
A shared high price
Proof of ancient ownership
connect us with places we call home
原文强调普通物品，并未以高价为共同点。
没有要求证明年代久远的所有权。
How does the exhibition treat belonging?
It welcomes different personal connections
It requires proof of long residence
It makes one person represent every resident
People can feel connected with more than one place.
展览不要求用居住年限证明归属感。
每个标签只讲述个人经历，不能代表所有居民。
How are the labels scoped?
To the presenter’s own experience
To every resident’s identical experience
To an official identity test
whose experience is being described
标签没有声称全镇经历相同。
展览不是官方身份测试。
Which idea best fits the exhibition?
Belonging can have different sources
Only long-term residents belong
One person must represent a whole town
different kinds of belonging
没有居住年限门槛。
每个标签说明个人经历，不代表全镇所有人。

texts.text:
THE WORD I USED TO HIDE
When I moved schools, I stopped using a word my family said for a small afternoon snack. I thought it would sound strange to everyone else. One day, our teacher asked us to collect examples of how ordinary things receive different names. I mentioned the word without giving my family's private details. A classmate recognised it; another asked what it meant. Neither response made the word less mine.
I later asked my aunt when she used it and wrote down her explanation with her permission. I was careful not to call it the only correct name or a word used by every family in our region. The small project did not settle every question about where I belonged. It helped me see that joining a new community does not require me to erase every earlier connection. I can learn new ways of speaking while explaining an old one clearly. Curiosity gave us a better conversation than deciding whose language sounded most normal.
items: Why did the narrator stop using the family word?
Fear that it would sound strange
A rule banning the word
Proof that nobody used it
I thought it would sound strange
没有禁止该词的规定。
后来有同学认出它，不能说无人使用。
How is the aunt’s explanation recorded?
With permission
By publishing her address
Without asking any question
with her permission
没有公布地址。
作者先询问姑姨怎样使用这个词。
What claim does the narrator avoid?
Every family in the region uses the word
The aunt gave an explanation
The word names a snack
a word used by every family in our region
姑姨给出解释是文中发生的事。
这个词确实指一种下午点心。
What does the narrator learn?
New connections need not erase earlier ones
All questions of identity are solved forever
Only one way of speaking is normal
does not require me to erase every earlier connection
文章明确没有解决所有归属问题。

texts.text:
THE PHOTOGRAPH WITH A NEW CAPTION
A dramatic photograph appeared in our class chat with the caption, 'Our river flooded this morning.' Before forwarding it, Jia asked where the picture came from. The first message she saw had no link, location or date. She found an earlier public post showing the same bridge and the same broken fence, but it described a different town several years earlier. That comparison was enough to challenge the new caption; it was not enough to explain every detail of the original event.
Jia told the group what she had checked and what remained unknown. She did not accuse every person who had shared it of deliberately lying. She also checked the current notice from the relevant local authority before making any claim about conditions near her own school. A striking image can be genuine while the words attached to it are misleading. Checking the origin and the current local situation are related tasks, but they answer different questions.
items: What is missing from the first message?
A source link, place and date
A dramatic caption
A photograph
no link, location or date
消息有醒目配文，不是没有配文。
整个核查正是围绕那张照片展开。
What does the older post help challenge?
The claim about the photo’s current local setting
Every detail of every flood
The existence of the photograph
enough to challenge the new caption
一次比对不能说明所有洪水细节。
找到同一图片不是否定图片存在。
What does Jia avoid assuming?
Every sharer intended to lie
Some details remain unknown
A current local notice is worth checking
She did not accuse every person who had shared it of deliberately lying.
她明确保留未知信息。
她确实进一步查看当前当地通告。
What is the main distinction?
A real image can have misleading words
Every old image is false
A caption proves the local situation
genuine while the words attached to it are misleading
旧图本身可以真实，只是被错配语境。

texts.text:
TWO HEADLINES, ONE SMALL SURVEY
These figures are invented for reading practice. A club asks twenty members whether they would try a weekly repair activity. Twelve say yes, five say no, and three are unsure. One proposed headline reads, 'Most young people now prefer repairs to new products.' Another reads, 'Twelve members of our club are interested in trying a repair activity.'
The first headline goes beyond the questions and the people actually surveyed. The club did not ask every young person, and interest in one activity does not prove a general shopping preference. The second headline stays closer to the available answers, though readers still need to know how the question was asked. A useful report should also include the people who said no or were unsure rather than hiding them. Small, honest findings can help a club plan its next step. They do not need to be turned into a sweeping story about a whole generation to become useful.
items: How many members are unsure?
Three
Five
Twelve
three are unsure
五人回答不愿意。
十二人回答愿意尝试。
Why is the first headline too broad?
It generalises beyond the group and question
It repeats the exact limited result
It mentions all three response groups
goes beyond the questions and the people actually surveyed
第一条不是准确复述有限结果，而是扩大范围。
第一条并未列出三组答案。
Which headline better matches the evidence?
Twelve club members are interested in a repair activity
All young people reject new products
Every club member agrees
Twelve members of our club are interested in trying a repair activity
没有调查全部年轻人，更未证明拒买新品。
五人不愿意，三人不确定，所以不是一致同意。
What should an honest report keep?
No and unsure responses as well
Only positive responses
Invented reasons for absent people
include the people who said no or were unsure
只报赞成会隐藏部分结果。
没问到的人不能被编造出原因。

texts.text:
TESTING A PAPER BRIDGE
Our team wanted to build a paper bridge across a small gap between two desks. The goal was not to claim that paper could replace a real road bridge. It was to compare two folded designs under the same classroom conditions. We used the same kind of paper, the same gap and the same small test objects. Before each trial, our teacher checked that the desks were stable and that nobody was underneath the bridge.
One design bent earlier than the other. We recorded that observation, but we did not call the second design the strongest bridge possible. We had tested only two versions. When we changed the fold again, we kept the other conditions the same and repeated the comparison. Our report includes the failed attempt because it helps explain the later decision. Engineering involves asking what a design must do, testing it fairly and recognising the limits of a model. An attractive photograph of the finished bridge cannot replace the record of how it performed.
items: What is the purpose of the test?
Comparing two classroom designs
Replacing a real road bridge
Proving the strongest possible bridge
compare two folded designs
文中明确不是替代真实公路桥。
只比较两种设计，不能证明最强极限。
Which condition is kept the same?
The gap between the desks
The identity of every future visitor
Every fold in every version
the same gap
未来访客不属于此次试验条件。
折法正是被改变、比较的设计因素。
Why keep the failed attempt in the report?
It explains the later decision
It makes failure disappear
It replaces every repeated test
it helps explain the later decision
保留记录不等于失败不存在。
后文实际重复比较，不能用记录替代所有试验。
Why does the report need more than a finished photograph?
Appearance does not show test performance
Photographs cannot show any shape
A photograph proves every design was tested
An attractive photograph of the finished bridge cannot replace the record of how it performed.
照片可以显示外形，问题在于外形不能代替性能记录。
一张成品照片不能证明每种设计都经过测试。

texts.text:
THE TOOL THAT STARTED WITH A QUESTION
This profile describes an invented school project. A student called Leila notices that visitors often pull a storage drawer too far and scatter its cards. Her first idea is a large warning sign. Some users notice it, but others are looking at the cards rather than the sign. Leila then works with her teacher to design a simple removable stop that limits the drawer's movement. They use a spare drawer for testing, not a piece of shared equipment that people are still using.
The stop is easy to remove for cleaning, but the first version is uncomfortable to hold. Leila asks several classmates to test a safer revised shape under the teacher's supervision. She records their comments, including disagreement. She does not name the tool a finished commercial product or assume everyone will find it easy to use. Her final presentation explains the need, the tests and the remaining problems. The invention is interesting because it responds to a real difficulty, not because every first idea works.
items: What problem starts the project?
Cards scatter when a drawer is pulled too far
The room has no cards
Every visitor ignores every sign
pull a storage drawer too far and scatter its cards
房间有卡片，问题不是没有卡片。
部分人注意到标志，不能说所有人无视所有标志。
Where is the design tested?
On a spare drawer
On busy shared equipment without asking
Inside a visitor’s private bag
use a spare drawer for testing
原文明确不占用仍在使用的共享设备。
没有翻动访客私人包。
What is wrong with the first version?
It is uncomfortable to hold
It cannot be removed for cleaning
It has no connection with a need
uncomfortable to hold
前文说可以方便取下清洁。
项目就是为解决抽屉问题而开始。
What does the final presentation include?
Tests and remaining problems
A claim of a finished commercial product
Only praise and no disagreement
the tests and the remaining problems
Leila 没有宣称它已成为成熟商品。
她保留了包括不同意见的反馈。

texts.text:
READ THE LANDSCAPE, FOLLOW THE ROUTE
This fictional walking guide describes a valley with a river path and a higher woodland path. The river path is flatter but may be closed after heavy rain. The higher path has steps, so it is not suitable for every visitor. Check the current local information before choosing either route; a printed guide cannot show today's conditions. Stay on marked paths and leave plants and stones where they are. A viewpoint is a place to look, not permission to climb beyond a barrier for a photograph. Carry your own water and take your litter back. Our guide uses a simple sketch to show the order of places, not their exact distances or sizes. To estimate the walking time, use the route information rather than measuring the drawing with a ruler.

The river path
The higher woodland path
Every possible route
The river path is flatter
高处林间路线有台阶，不是文中较平的路线。
文章只比较两条，不能推广到所有路线。
Why check current information?
Printed guides cannot show today’s conditions
Every printed word is false
The river never changes
a printed guide cannot show today's conditions
信息可能过时不等于所有印刷文字都错误。

What does the sketch show?
The order of places
Exact sizes and distances
A guarantee of safe weather

How should walking time be estimated?
Using route information
Measuring the sketch with a ruler
Assuming every route takes ten minutes
use the route information

texts.text:
A RIVER WALK: SCHEMATIC, NOT TO SCALE
Starting point: visitor centre.
Next place: wooden viewing platform.
Final place on this route: the old stone bridge.
The river continues beyond the bridge, but our marked route does not. Arrows on this simple guide show the visiting order, not the direction in which every part of the river flows. Before leaving the centre, ask whether the whole marked path is open. The platform is for observing the river from behind its rail. It is not a place to enter the water. On the far bank, a broad line of trees provides a useful feature for comparing the view with the guide. A feature can help you recognise a place without telling you exactly how far away it is. The return journey follows the same marked path unless current staff guidance says otherwise.

The old stone bridge
The visitor centre
The viewing platform
Final place on this route: the old stone bridge.
游客中心是起点。
观景台是中间地点。
What do the arrows show?
Visiting order
All water-flow directions
Exact distances
show the visiting order

示意图不按比例，不提供精确距离。
What is the platform for?
Observing from behind the rail
Entering the river
Climbing outside the rail
observing the river from behind its rail
说明明确不是下水地点。
观察应在护栏内，不是翻越护栏。
What can the tree line help with?
Recognising the place
Knowing an exact distance by itself
Proving the route is open today
help you recognise a place

title: 野生动物与共同生活：读懂信息与用意

texts.text:
WATCHING WITHOUT FEEDING
Our nature club watched birds from a marked path beside a wetland. We kept our voices low and used the viewing area instead of moving closer to a nest. One visitor wanted to offer bread to bring the birds nearer. Our guide asked us not to feed them and explained that watching should not change their normal behaviour. We recorded the time, weather and features we could actually see. When two birds looked similar, we wrote 'identity uncertain' rather than choosing a name because it sounded impressive. A distant photograph was sometimes unclear, but that did not make stepping off the path a good solution. The aim was to learn about animals while giving them space. Our notes include things we did not know, so another observer can tell the difference between an observation and a guess.
items: Why does the guide stop the feeding idea?
Observation should not change normal behaviour
Bread always improves every wild bird’s health
The group must touch a nest
watching should not change their normal behaviour
文中没有面包适合所有野鸟的保证。
小组保持距离，没有触碰巢的要求。
Where does the group watch from?
A marked path and viewing area
Inside a nest
Any place beyond the path
from a marked path
他们没有进入鸟巢。
照片不清晰也不能成为离开标记路线的理由。
How are similar birds recorded?
Identity uncertain
With a guessed impressive name
As definitely the same individual
identity uncertain
选好听的名称不能解决辨认问题。
相似不等于确定是同一只。
What do the notes distinguish?
Observations and guesses
Only beautiful and ugly birds
Visitors with and without phones
an observation and a guess
记录关注可见特征与不确定性，不按美丑分类。
文章没有按手机情况划分访客。

texts.text:
WHEN WILDLIFE VISITS OUR STREET
Residents sometimes see small wild animals near the trees behind our building. A class poster reminds people to watch from a distance and leave a clear way for the animal to move away. It does not invite anyone to catch an animal for a better photograph. Keep household rubbish secured and follow local advice about pets and wildlife. If an animal appears injured or trapped, tell a responsible adult, who can contact the appropriate local service. Children should not try to handle it themselves. The poster leaves space for the actual local contact details to be added by the organiser; invented numbers would not help. Sharing a neighbourhood with wildlife includes reducing disturbance and asking for qualified help when needed. A friendly intention does not automatically make every action helpful to the animal.
items: What should an animal be allowed to do?
Move away through a clear space
Pose while being caught
Eat household rubbish
leave a clear way for the animal to move away
海报没有鼓励抓住动物拍照。
垃圾需要妥善收好，不是拿来喂动物。
What should a child do about an injured animal?
Tell a responsible adult
Handle it alone
Guess a contact number
tell a responsible adult
文中明确不要自行接触处理。
虚构电话号码不能提供有效帮助。
Why is space left for contact details?
Real local details must be added
Any invented number will work
The organiser wants every child’s private address
actual local contact details
原文明确虚构号码无用。
需要的是服务联系方式，不是孩子家庭住址。
What is the main lesson?
Helpful actions need care, distance and suitable support
Good intentions justify all actions
Every wild animal should become a pet
does not automatically make every action helpful
结尾否定仅凭善意就合理化所有行为。
文章关注野生动物共处，没有要求收养成宠物。

title: 污染成因与可行的环保行动：读懂信息与用意
goal: 先判断文本要解决什么问题，再用原文证据核对细节、因果和作者的用意。
