texts.text:
WHERE THE LITTER COMES FROM
Our class counted visible litter along the same short path on three afternoons. These fictional classroom observations are not a scientific survey of the whole town. We recorded wrappers, paper pieces and drink containers without opening bags or handling sharp or unknown waste. On windy days, more light paper collected near the fence. That pattern suggested a question about where the paper came from, but it did not prove who had dropped it. Some might have blown from a nearby open container.
We shared the notes with the school worker and asked whether a covered bin and a clearer collection routine could be tried. We did not accuse the nearest class simply because its door was close. Our next step was to observe the same place after a small change. Environmental action becomes more useful when it addresses a possible cause and checks what happens, rather than turning a limited count into a story about careless people everywhere.
items: What is the scope of the observations?
One short path on three afternoons
The whole town for a year
Every kind of hidden waste
along the same short path on three afternoons
文章明确不是全镇一年调查。
只记可见垃圾，没有翻查所有隐藏废物。
What does the windy-day pattern suggest?
A question about where paper comes from
Proof of the person who dropped every piece
Proof that all paper is harmless
suggested a question
原文明确不能据此确定丢垃圾者。
没有据此证明纸张完全无害。
Which change is proposed?
A covered bin and clearer collection
Opening unknown waste bags
Blaming the nearest class
a covered bin and a clearer collection routine
记录过程不打开垃圾袋。
他们明确没有只凭距离指责邻班。
What should happen after the change?
Observe the same place again
Claim the whole town is clean
Stop checking every result
observe the same place after a small change
只试一处不能宣布全镇清洁。
行动后仍需检验效果。

texts.text:
DID OUR REFILL PLAN HELP?
For one school club, we tried providing a water-refill point during meetings. The following figures are fictional: before the trial, the club used thirty disposable cups at one meeting; during the trial, it used eighteen. The decrease was twelve cups for those two observed meetings. We cannot assume the same result for every meeting or every club. Attendance and activities can change.
Some students forgot their bottles, so the plan still needed a practical backup. We did not ask anyone to go without drinking water. We also asked who would clean and maintain the refill area. A change that reduces one kind of waste should not quietly leave extra work to an unnamed person. Our report recommends continuing the trial, explaining the arrangements clearly and collecting further observations. It does not call the problem solved. Honest evaluation includes the remaining difficulties as well as the improvement we hoped to see, so the next decision can be based on more than a cheerful slogan.
items: How many fewer disposable cups are observed?
Twelve
Eighteen
Thirty
The decrease was twelve cups
十八是试行时使用数，不是减少数。
三十是试行前使用数，不是减少数。
Why is the conclusion limited?
Attendance and activities may change
The figures describe every club
A decrease proves the problem is solved
Attendance and activities can change.
数据只属于这个社团两次观察。
报告明确不宣称问题解决。
What should the backup protect?
Access to drinking water
A perfect-looking result at any cost
A ban on students who forget bottles
We did not ask anyone to go without drinking water.
不能为了数据好看而让人缺水。
文中没有因忘带瓶子而禁止参加。
Which responsibility must be named?
Cleaning and maintaining the area
Buying everyone a new phone
Writing only a cheerful slogan
who would clean and maintain the refill area
手机与补水区维护无关。

title: 自然灾害与安全准备：读懂信息与用意
goal: 先判断文本要解决什么问题，再用原文证据核对细节、因果和作者的用意。

texts.text:
OUR SCHOOL PRACTICE SESSION
This is a notice about a planned safety exercise, not a live warning. Before the session, your teacher will explain the current school plan, the agreed signal and the meeting point. Listen carefully and ask if you are unsure. During the exercise, follow staff instructions and keep the route clear. Do not return for a bag or stop to make a video. If you become separated, tell a member of staff rather than leaving the supervised area alone. After the exercise, the class will discuss which instructions were clear and which need explaining again. A practice session is useful when it helps people understand a plan. It is not a race to see who can reach the meeting point first. Actual emergencies require current local guidance, not assumptions based only on a classroom text.
items: What is this notice about?
A planned practice session
A confirmed live disaster
A speed competition
a planned safety exercise, not a live warning
通知明确不是实时灾害警报。
结尾明确不是比谁最快。
What should students ask about beforehand?
Unclear parts of the current plan
How to make the best video
How to leave supervision alone
ask if you are unsure
演练中不应停下来拍视频。
走失时应找工作人员，不是自行脱离。
What should NOT interrupt the route?
Returning for a bag
Following staff instructions
Keeping the route clear
Do not return for a bag
服从工作人员是要求，不是应避免的行为。
保持路线畅通也是要求。
What does practice mainly aim to improve?
Understanding the plan
A ranking by running speed
Confidence that guidance never changes

演练不是按速度排名。

texts.text:
WHEN HEAVY RAIN IS EXPECTED
Our class is planning a visit, and heavy rain may affect the route. The teacher will check current official information and the school's arrangements before deciding whether the visit can go ahead. Families should use the confirmed school message rather than an undated screenshot forwarded through several chats. Students can prepare by knowing how to contact a trusted adult and keeping agreed contact information available privately. Do not enter floodwater or touch fallen cables to investigate a problem. Tell an adult and keep away. If the trip is postponed, the new time will be announced through the usual school channel. A change of plan is not a reason to search for a shortcut around a closed route. The checklist helps with preparation; it does not replace instructions from responsible local staff during an actual event.
items: What information should guide the visit decision?
Current official information and school arrangements
An undated forwarded screenshot alone
A student’s guess about a shortcut
current official information and the school's arrangements
无日期截图不能单独证明当前情况。
猜近路不是负责的决策依据。
How should contact information be kept?
Privately available for the agreed purpose
Posted publicly for everyone
Invented when needed
available privately
联系资料不应公开给所有人。
临时编造号码不能帮助联系成人。
What should someone do near fallen cables?
Keep away and tell an adult
Touch them to check
Enter floodwater to take a closer look
Tell an adult and keep away.
清单明确不要触碰掉落电线。
也不要进入积水探查。
Where will a postponed trip’s new time appear?
The usual school channel
Any anonymous comment
A guessed timetable
through the usual school channel

title: 地球、太空与探索：读懂信息与用意
goal: 先判断文本要解决什么问题，再用原文证据核对细节、因果和作者的用意。
pitfall: 相近的词或出现过的数字不一定回答本题；推断也必须有原文支持。

LOOKING AT THE MOON CAREFULLY
Our class observed the Moon from a safe viewing place over several evenings. We wrote down the time and the visible shape, and we noted when clouds blocked the view. We did not record a cloudy evening as proof that the Moon had disappeared. The Moon does not produce its own visible light like the Sun; we see sunlight reflected from it. Its changing appearance during a month does not mean that a piece of the Moon is being removed and replaced.
Our teacher asked us to separate observation from explanation. A drawing can record the shape we see, while a model may help us explore why appearances change. The model needs labels and a warning when sizes or distances are not to scale. A small ball beside a lamp is useful for thinking, but it is not a complete copy of the Earth-Moon system. Good exploration includes careful notes, useful models and clear statements about what those models leave out.
items: What does a cloudy evening show in these notes?
The view was blocked
The Moon ceased to exist
The Moon stopped reflecting forever
clouds blocked the view
看不见不等于月球不存在。
云遮挡不能证明月球永不再反射光。
Why can we see the Moon?
It reflects sunlight
It makes light like the Sun
A new piece is added each night
sunlight reflected from it
原文明说不是像太阳那样自己发出可见光。
形状变化不是每晚添一块月球。
What warning can a classroom model need?
Sizes or distances may not be to scale
It is a perfect copy in every detail
The lamp is the real Sun
sizes or distances are not to scale
文中明确小球模型不是完整复制。
台灯只是模型中的光源，不是真实太阳。
What does careful exploration require?
Distinguishing observations and explanations
Calling every drawing a full explanation
Ignoring evenings without a clear view
separate observation from explanation
记录外观和解释成因并不是同一件事。
云遮挡也应记在观测条件中，而非忽略。

A MISSION ON PAPER
Our science club designed a fictional mission to study a distant rocky world. We did not choose a real launch date or claim that our paper design could fly. First, we decided what question the mission should answer. We wanted to compare surface pictures from two areas, so a camera was more important to our plan than a device for collecting sound. We then considered power, communication and the limits of the pictures.
A clear image would not tell us everything about the material beneath the surface. Nor would one interesting shape prove that life had been found. Our report lists what further evidence would be needed before making a stronger claim. Because our map is invented, every place name is marked as fictional. The project helped us practise asking a focused question and matching a tool to it. Space exploration can inspire large hopes, but a useful investigation still needs precise aims, honest uncertainty and a way to explain how the evidence supports a conclusion.
items: What is the mission’s status?
A fictional design project
A confirmed real launch
An official discovery of life
designed a fictional mission
文中没有真实发射日期。
项目没有宣布发现生命。
Why is a camera important?
The question involves comparing surface pictures
The team wants only sound recordings
A camera explains everything below the surface
compare surface pictures from two areas
团队的问题不是仅记录声音。
后文说明表面图像不能揭示地下全部情况。
Which conclusion would be premature from one interesting shape?
Life has been found
The image can lead to a new question
Further evidence could be useful
Nor would one interesting shape prove that life had been found.
图像可以引出新问题，但不能单凭一个形状断定已发现生命。
继续寻找证据是合理的，原文反对的是缺乏证据就宣布结论。
What makes an investigation useful?
Focused aims and evidence with stated limits
Invented places presented as real
Large hopes without a clear question
precise aims, honest uncertainty
文中明确给虚构地名作标记，不冒充真实地点。
全文强调先提出具体问题，不只依赖宏大愿望。
